name: Makeni
queryAndRequestSummary: Separate English and Krio-language first-party discovery searches identified the MLHCP portal, the Makeni regional Surveys and Lands office evidence, the National Land Commission, and the SLLAP site. The current MLHCP service pages expose survey and registration workflows but require account access; the NLC digital portal explicitly remains under development. No anonymous parcel viewer, service configuration, schema/CRS, or safe ID+geometry response was found. No GeoJSON sample was created.
